thread:
anya: noticing an onboarding spike in quotas during signup flows. some users hit 429s immediately after clicking Sign up. digging in now.

sam: i reproduced. sample-app prefetch=3 + immediate signup -> auth refresh -> multiple identical page fetches. server logs show 4 concurrent GETs for same cursor then 429s.

lee: quick guess: no in-flight dedupe and prefetch loop restarts on token refresh. two simple fixes: singleflight by cursor, and pause prefetch while token refresh running.

anya: minimal repro steps: set SAMPLE_PREFETCH=3, start app, force token expiry at 1s, click Signup. network tab shows repeated `/list?cursor=abc`.

peter: sketch of singleflight: ```js
if (inFlight.has(key)) return inFlight.get(key)
const p = fetchPage(key)
inFlight.set(key, p)
p.finally(()=> inFlight.delete(key))
return p
```

sam: also add AbortController per fetch to cancel stale prefetches when user navigates or a newer fetch supersedes. reduces wasted requests.

lee: we should add prefetchMode options: "default", "onboarding" (conservative), and "dedupe" (singleflight). onboarding sets maxConcurrency=1-2 and pauses on auth.refresh.

anya: parity concern: go/python SDKs need the same flags. add a small interface change: prefetch: { mode: 'onboarding' | 'default' | 'dedupe' }. non-breaking default is "default".

ci-bot: created job devex/prefetch-onboard-e2e to run in staging with forced token expiry.

sam: i'll prototype singleflight + AbortController + telemetry metric `sdk.prefetch.duplicates`. small perf cost but necessary to measure reduction. will open PR and tag dx teams.

peter: docs: update onboarding guide to recommend prefetchMode="onboarding" for starter kits and mention token expiry caveat.

anya: thanks. quick action: reduce SAMPLE_PREFETCH in sample-app starter to 1 until this lands. follow-up sync tomorrow 10:30.
